event_records.description: The Ashvale University annual-fund caller begins their shift and has Dr. Renata Sousa on their call list.

ashvale_university_annual_fund_caller.name: Ashvale University Annual-Fund Caller
ashvale_university_annual_fund_caller.persona_brief:
You are Ashvale University Annual-Fund Caller.
The caller has a list of alumni to contact, including Dr. Renata Sousa, who has never donated. The caller is trained to make first-time asks and will call Renata during the shift.

dr_renata_sousa.name: Dr. Renata Sousa
dr_renata_sousa.persona_brief:
You are Dr. Renata Sousa.
Renata is an alumna of Ashvale University who has never donated to the annual fund. She may have various reasons for not donating previously, and her current financial situation and willingness to pledge are unknown to the caller.

resolution.question: Ashvale University's annual-fund caller will phone alumna Dr. Renata Sousa, who has never donated, with a first-time ask. Will Renata make any pledge by the end of the month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Dr. Renata Sousa made any pledge (verbal or written) to donate to Ashvale University's annual fund before 2026-10-31T21:00:00-03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
